arms.E: budgeted reachability (frozen section 36 policy, REACH_BUDGET 20, replace); no fallback; floor 0
arms.EFb: E + E_SYNTH_FALLBACK (one synthetic-trajectory retry per machine after a reachable-table Update failure); floor 0
arms.EFc: E; no fallback; MIN_SYNTH_CPU 10 (per main-round synthesis floor inside the formation deadline)

criteria.CAUSAL_DEVELOPMENT_PASS: an E-family arm has more verified solves than A on the 24 new compositions under the same caps, robust over the replicates, with no robust verified regression on the 36 tasks
criteria.EFFICIENCY_PASS: an arm with verified accuracy >= A's (on all 36) has lower total compute (real CPU; formation SOURCE queries reported separately)
criteria.REGRESSION_RECOVERY_PASS: an arm with the fallback recovers the section-36 regression type (A solves, E fails by a reachable-table Update failure) on the regression set or new tasks, by the general fallback, and creates no new regression vs A (robust over the replicates)

first_run: all 5 arms x 36 tasks, base seed
harness: research/q3/budgeted_reach_dev.py (run_arm('D') as active_dev.job; Env(spec, 0, budget=60); seed sha256(name) % 1000; fresh process per (arm, task, seed); --semantic)
metrics: verified solves (hidden test + every random diagnostic input correct)
new / lost verified solves vs A and vs E
semantic accuracy on random diagnostic inputs
fallback rate and verified solves after fallback
CPU and formation queries per verified solve
no_post_hoc: floor value, fallback rule, REACH_BUDGET, priorities and task lists are not changed after this commit
not_counted: the two section-36 regression tasks used to debug the fallback (keep-mod-k(k=2) | pow-k(k=3), remove-mod-k(k=3) | add-k(k=-2)) and every earlier task
replication: every task whose verified outcome differs between any two arms: 2 more same-seed runs and seeds 1, 2 (sha256(name) + 7919 k), all 5 arms
status: FROZEN before any run on the evaluation set (development only)
